# Comparisons

This folder contains the structured data tables and comparative analyses extracted from the DANIBD annual reports, covering the years 2023 through 2025. It serves as the quantitative backbone of the wiki, detailing regional and departmental performance against national quality indicators, demographic breakdowns of pediatric and adult IBD cohorts, and the frequency of specific biologic treatments and surgical procedures. Every page preserves the exact rows, columns, and statistical outliers from the original PDF tables, allowing readers to trace systemic successes and failures in Danish IBD care directly back to the source data.

## Pages

- [[aarsag-til-ikke-opfyldt-indikator|Årsag til ikke opfyldt indikator]] — Breaks down the specific missing examinations (like MRI or capsule endoscopy) that caused pediatric patients to fail Indikator 1b.
- [[appendikstabel-1-patientkarakteristika-pr-behandlende-region|Appendikstabel 1. Patientkarakteristika pr. behandlende region]] — Compares demographic and diagnostic distributions of IBD patients across Denmark's five regions for the 2022-2023 period.
- [[appendikstabel-1-patientkarakteristiska-pr-region|"Appendikstabel 1: Patientkarakteristiska pr. region"]] — Provides a 2025 cross-sectional snapshot of regional disparities in patient volume, age, and healthcare utilization across Danish regions.
- [[appendikstabel-2-afdelinger-der-har-indrapporteret-undervisningskoder-i-perioden-indikator-2|"Appendikstabel 2. Afdelinger, der har indrapporteret undervisningskoder i perioden (indikator 2)"]] — Lists hospital departments and their volume of registered patient education codes, highlighting significant disparities in reporting.
- [[appendikstabel-2-karakteristika-for-nydiagnosticeret-voksne-ved-foerste-kontakt-i-forloebet-indikator-1a|"Appendikstabel 2: Karakteristika for nydiagnosticeret voksne ved første kontakt i forløbet (indikator 1a)"]] — Details the baseline demographic and clinical profile of newly diagnosed adult IBD patients entering the registry.
- [[appendikstabel-3-karakteristika-for-nydiagnosticeret-boern-og-unge-ved-foerste-kontakt-i-forloebet-indikator-1b|"Appendikstabel 3: Karakteristika for nydiagnosticeret børn og unge ved første kontakt i forløbet (indikator 1b)"]] — Outlines the characteristics of newly diagnosed pediatric IBD patients, showing a strong predominance of Crohn's disease and adolescent males.
- [[appendikstabel-3-karakteristika-for-patienter-i-behandling-med-bmsl-indikator-4|Appendikstabel 3. Karakteristika for patienter i behandling med BMSL (indikator 4)]] — Contrasts the demographic and diagnostic profiles of pediatric versus adult patients receiving biologic and targeted synthetic therapies.
- [[appendikstabel-4-karakteristika-for-patienter-i-behandling-med-bmsl|"Appendikstabel 4: Karakteristika for patienter i behandling med BMSL"]] — Analyzes age, gender, and diagnostic distributions among BMSL-treated patients, noting rare conditions like PSC only appear in the pediatric cohort.
- [[appendikstabel-4-type-og-antal-behandlinger-med-bmsl-indikator-4|Appendikstabel 4. Type og antal behandlinger med BMSL (indikator 4)]] — Compares the distribution of specific biologic treatments, revealing infliximab's overwhelming dominance in pediatric care compared to a more varied adult landscape.
- [[appendikstabel-5-karakteristika-for-patienter-i-behandling-med-bmsl-paa-afdelingsniveau-indikator-5|"Appendikstabel 5: Karakteristika for patienter i behandling med BMSL på afdelingsniveau (indikator 5)"]] — Maps BMSL patient volumes and demographics across specific Danish hospital departments, identifying leaders and trailers in treatment capacity.
- [[appendikstabel-5-typer-af-kirurgiske-indgreb-foretaget-paa-patienter-med-ibd-indikator-6|Appendikstabel 5. Typer af kirurgiske indgreb foretaget på patienter med IBD (indikator 6)]] — Catalogs the frequency of specific surgical procedure codes for IBD patients, with laparoscopic colectomy and ileostomy leading the list.
- [[appendikstabel-6-typer-af-re-operationer-foretaget-paa-patienter-med-ibd-indikator-6|Appendikstabel 6. Typer af re-operationer foretaget på patienter med IBD (indikator 6)]] — Details the types of surgical re-operations performed, showing endoscopic dilations and small intestine resections as the most common interventions.
- [[appendikstabel-6-typer-og-antal-behandlinger-med-bmsl-indikator-5|"Appendikstabel 6: Typer og antal behandlinger med BMSL (indikator 5)"]] — Tracks the volume of specific BMSL treatment codes administered to children and adults in the 2024-2025 period, highlighting demographic divergences in drug usage.
- [[appendikstabel-7-karakteristika-for-patienter-med-psc-indikator-7|Appendikstabel 7. Karakteristika for patienter med PSC (indikator 7)]] — Examines the demographics and hospital contact patterns of newly diagnosed versus prevalent Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis patients.
- [[appendikstabel-7-typer-af-kirurgiske-indgreb-foretaget-paa-patienter-med-ibd-indikator-6|"Appendikstabel 7: Typer af kirurgiske indgreb foretaget på patienter med IBD (indikator 6)"]] — Provides a 2025 breakdown of surgical interventions for IBD, showing that a significant fraction falls into an "Other" miscellaneous category.
- [[appendikstabel-8-typer-af-re-operationer-foretaget-paa-patienter-med-ibd-indikator-6|"Appendikstabel 8: Typer af re-operationer foretaget på patienter med IBD (indikator 6)"]] — Compares 2025 re-operation types, revealing that exploratory laparotomies and laparoscopies account for over half of all surgical reinterventions.
- [[figur-over-antallet-af-patienter-der-er-inkluderet-i-danibd-fra-databasens-start-d-1-oktober-2022-frem-til-30-september-2025-fordelt-paa-de-tre-opgoerelsesperioder|"Figur over antallet af patienter, der er inkluderet i DANIBD fra databasens start d. 1. oktober 2022 frem til 30. september 2025 fordelt på de tre opgørelsesperioder"]] — Visualizes patient retention and contact patterns across three annual reporting periods, showing the vast majority maintain continuous engagement.
- [[indikator-1a-andelen-af-nydiagnosticerede-voksne-med-ibd-der-har-faaet-foretaget-relevant-udredning|"Indikator 1a: Andelen af nydiagnosticerede voksne med IBD, der har fået foretaget relevant udredning"]] — Evaluates regional and departmental compliance with the standard diagnostic workup for newly diagnosed adult IBD patients.
- [[indikator-1a|Indikator 1a]] — Tracks the proportion of newly diagnosed adults receiving a colonoscopy, comparing national, regional, and departmental performance across two reporting years.
- [[indikator-1b|Indikator 1b]] — Measures the completion rate of the full three-part diagnostic workup for pediatric IBD patients, highlighting severe regional shortfalls in Nordjylland.
- [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]] — Monitors the proportion of newly diagnosed IBD patients receiving post-diagnosis education within one year, exposing a stark regional disparity with Sjælland trailing at 1%.
- [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]] — Assesses the rate of post-operative colonoscopies within one year for adults with Crohn's disease who underwent an ileocecal resection.
- [[indikator-4-andelen-af-patienter-med-ibd-i-behandling-med-bmsl-der-faar-maalt-f-calpro-mindst-en-gang-aarligt|"Indikator 4: Andelen af patienter med IBD i behandling med BMSL, der får målt F-calpro mindst én gang årligt"]] — Compares departmental adherence to annual fecal calprotectin monitoring for patients on biologic therapies, showing pediatrics vastly outperforming adult units.
- [[indikator-4-andelen-af-steroidkure-givet-til-patienter-over-50-aar-med-ibd-hvor-patienten-har-faaet-foretaget-dexa-scanning|"Indikator 4: Andelen af steroidkure givet til patienter over 50 år med IBD, hvor patienten har fået foretaget DEXA-scanning"]] — Evaluates the provision of DEXA scans for older IBD patients on steroids, revealing a systemic failure to meet the 80% bone-density monitoring target.
- [[indikator-4|Indikator 4]] — Tracks the proportion of steroid courses accompanied by DEXA scans across regions and departments, showing universal failure to meet the national target.
- [[indikator-5-andelen-af-patienter-i-behandling-med-bmsl-der-faar-maalt-f-calprotectin-mindst-en-gang-aarligt|"Indikator 5: Andelen af patienter i behandling med BMSL, der får målt F-calprotectin mindst én gang årligt"]] — Evaluates national and departmental compliance with annual calprotectin measurement targets for BMSL patients, highlighting structural outliers between pediatric and adult care.
- [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]] — Monitors fecal calprotectin measurement rates for patients on biologic therapies, showing national target achievement but significant departmental variance.
- [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]] — Tracks 30-day surgical re-operation rates for IBD patients, documenting a national deterioration from a 4% rate in 2023 to a target-missing 13% in 2024.
- [[indikator-7|Indikator 7]] — Measures the rate of 18-month colonoscopy screenings for adults with Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis, tracking regional compliance with cancer-surveillance standards.
- [[karakteristika-for-patienter-i-behandling-med-bmsl-paa-landsplan-indikator-5|Karakteristika for patienter i behandling med BMSL på landsplan (indikator 5)]] — Outlines the national demographic and diagnostic profiles of pediatric and adult patients receiving BMSL therapies.
- [[karakteristika-for-patienter-med-psc-indikator-7|Karakteristika for patienter med PSC (indikator 7)]] — Contrasts the demographics and healthcare utilization of newly diagnosed versus prevalent PSC patients, noting a strong male predominance.
- [[patientkarakteristika-for-nydiagnosticerede-og-praevalente-boern-med-ibd-med-en-kontakt-til-et-hospital-i-perioden-1-oktober-2022-til-og-med-30-september-2023|Patientkarakteristika for nydiagnosticerede og prævalente børn med IBD med en kontakt til et hospital i perioden 1. oktober 2022 til og med 30. september 2023]] — Compares the clinical and demographic burden of pediatric IBD between newly diagnosed and prevalent cohorts for the 2022-2023 period.
- [[tabel-1-patientkarakteristika-for-nydiagnosticerede-og-praevalente-boern-med-ibd-med-en-kontakt-til-et-hospital-i-perioden-1-oktober-2023-til-og-med-30-september-2024|Tabel 1. Patientkarakteristika for nydiagnosticerede og prævalente børn med IBD med en kontakt til et hospital i perioden 1. oktober 2023 til og med 30. september 2024]] — Analyzes 2023-2024 pediatric IBD cohorts, showing Crohn's disease dominates new diagnoses while older adolescents make up the vast majority of cases.
- [[tabel-1-patientkarakteristika-for-nydiagnosticerede-og-praevalente-boern-med-ibd-med-en-kontakt-til-et-hospital-i-perioden-1-oktober-2024-til-og-med-30-september-2025|Tabel 1. Patientkarakteristika for nydiagnosticerede og prævalente børn med IBD med en kontakt til et hospital i perioden 1. oktober 2024 til og med 30. september 2025]] — Details 2024-2025 pediatric hospital contacts, confirming the continued dominance of physical consultations and adolescent males in IBD care.
- [[tabel-2-patientkarakteristika-for-nydiagnosticerede-og-praevalente-voksne-med-en-kontakt-til-et-hospital-i-perioden-1-oktober-2022-til-og-med-30-september-2023|Tabel 2. Patientkarakteristika for nydiagnosticerede og prævalente voksne med en kontakt til et hospital i perioden 1. oktober 2022 til og med 30. september 2023]] — Provides a demographic snapshot of adult IBD patients, contrasting the younger age of newly diagnosed individuals with the older, prevalent population.
- [[tabel-2-patientkarakteristika-for-nydiagnosticerede-og-praevalente-voksne-med-en-kontakt-til-et-hospital-i-perioden-1-oktober-2023-til-og-med-30-september-2024|Tabel 2. Patientkarakteristika for nydiagnosticerede og prævalente voksne med en kontakt til et hospital i perioden 1. oktober 2023 til og med 30. september 2024]] — Compares 2023-2024 adult IBD cohorts, highlighting ulcerative colitis as the leading diagnosis and physical attendance as the primary contact method.
- [[tabel-2-patientkarakteristika-for-nydiagnosticerede-og-praevalente-voksne-med-en-kontakt-til-et-hospital-i-perioden-1-oktober-2024-til-og-med-30-september-2025|Tabel 2. Patientkarakteristika for nydiagnosticerede og prævalente voksne med en kontakt til et hospital i perioden 1. oktober 2024 til og med 30. september 2025.]] — Examines 2024-2025 adult IBD characteristics, noting a slight male majority in new diagnoses versus a female majority in prevalent cases.
- [[tabel-3-oversigt-over-de-samlede-indikatorresultater|Tabel 3. Oversigt over de samlede indikatorresultater]] — Aggregates national quality indicator results across multiple years, exposing severe implementation gaps in patient education and osteoporosis prevention.
- [[tabel-3-oversigt-over-indikatorresultaterne-paa-landsplan|Tabel 3. Oversigt over indikatorresultaterne på landsplan]] — Evaluates 2024 national fulfillment of clinical quality indicators, showing only calprotectin monitoring and PSC follow-up met their targets.
- [[tabel-4-oversigt-over-indikatorresultaterne-paa-landsplan|Tabel 4. Oversigt over indikatorresultaterne på landsplan]] — Summarizes 2023 national indicator performance, noting that several key metrics were awaiting complete follow-up data.
- [[type-og-antal-behandlinger-med-bmsl-indikator-5|Type og antal behandlinger med BMSL (indikator 5)]] — Breaks down the volume of specific biologic treatments by age group, confirming infliximab's dominance and highlighting drugs with zero adult usage.
- [[typer-af-kirurgiske-indgreb-foretaget-paa-patienter-med-ibd-indikator-6|Typer af kirurgiske indgreb foretaget på patienter med IBD (indikator 6)]] — Lists 2023-2024 SMR procedure codes for IBD surgeries, showing laparoscopic ileocecal resection as the most frequent specific intervention.
- [[typer-af-re-operationer-foretaget-paa-patienter-med-ibd-indikator-6|Typer af re-operationer foretaget på patienter med IBD (indikator 6)]] — Details 2023-2024 re-operation procedures, revealing a heavy reliance on exploratory laparotomies and laparoscopies for surgical revisions.
